source:
## Semantics: U2 (rs#574 option A) — the whole-string shape: a
## quote-delimited named rule (quote Rep{0,∞}( interior ) quote) emits
## ONE span value, quotes folded in; the per-char iteration spans
## leave the wire. Accept/reject and the failure surface stay
## identical to the choice loop it replaces.
grammar ConformanceStringSpan version "1.0.0" edition "v2" {
  ## The json string rule's shape: the plain run excludes quote and
  ## backslash; the escape set is the two-char forms plus the
  ## u-hexquad (ABNF 4*, open-ended — hex sits inside the plain run).
  string = ( %x22 *( %x20-21 / %x23-5B / %x5D-10FFFF / %x5C ( %x22 / %x5C / %x2F / %x62 / %x66 / %x6E / %x72 / %x74 / ( %x75 4*( %x30-39 / %x41-46 / %x61-66 ) ) ) ) %x22 ) as string

  entry main: string

  test main {
    accept "\"plain\""
    accept "\"\""
    accept "\"esc \\\" q\""
    accept "\"hex \\u0041\""
    accept "\"日本語 \\u0041 ☃\""
    reject "\"short \\u123\""
    reject "\"bad \\q escape\""
    reject "\"unterminated"
    capture "\"whole \\u0042\"" { string: "\"whole \\u0042\"" }
  }
}
